review_candidates.title: Software Developer, Deploy & Run
review_candidates.description: Ilir Sela started Slice with the belief that local pizzerias deserve all of the advantages of major franchises without compromising their independence. Starting with his family’s pizzerias, we now empower over tens of thousands of restaurants with the technology, services, and collective power that owners need to better serve their digitally minded customers and build lasting businesses. We’re growing and adding more talent to help fulfil this valuable mission. That’s where you come in. This position is open to applicants across all of the UK on a remote basis, with the physical office located in Belfast, Northern Ireland. There are several openings within our Services team so we welcome applications from candidates seeking associate, intermediate or senior level positions. What You'll Do As a Platform Engineer on the DevEx Deploy & Run team, you'll build and evolve the platform that powers engineering across Slice. You'll work closely with product engineering teams to improve developer experience while raising the bar for reliability, security, and operational excellence. You Will Build and maintain our Internal Developer Platform, making it easier for engineers to deploy, operate, and troubleshoot their services. Create self-service tooling and automation that eliminate repetitive work and reduce operational overhead. Design and implement GitOps workflows using ArgoCD to provide safe, repeatable, and scalable application delivery. Improve our Kubernetes platform by developing reusable patterns, templates, and guardrails that make the right thing the easy thing. Build internal applications and developer tooling in Python that simplify infrastructure management and operational workflows. Enhance CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, improving deployment speed, consistency, and developer productivity. Use generative AI to help build and maintain internal services, including agentic services Improve observability by leveraging Datadog dashboards, metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting to help teams operate confidently in production. Partner with product engineering teams to understand pain points and continuously improve the developer experience. Reduce cognitive load for engineers by standardizing workflows, automating infrastructure operations, and providing well-documented platform capabilities. Champion engineering best practices around reliability, security, automation, and platform adoption. Our Technology Our platform is constantly evolving, but some of the technologies you'll work with include: Kubernetes ArgoCD & GitOps Python GitHub & GitHub Actions Datadog AWS Generative AI (Claude Code & AI Agents) Terraform Docker More important than experience with every individual tool is a passion for building platforms that make other engineers more productive. Who You Are We're looking for engineers who enjoy building platforms rather than products—people who love automation, reducing complexity, and enabling others to move faster. The Ideal Candidate Has Platform mindset You think in terms of reusable systems instead of one-off fixes. You enjoy creating platforms, guardrails, and automation that improve the experience of dozens or hundreds of engineers. Strong Automation Skills You're comfortable writing production-quality software—particularly in Python—to automate infrastructure, build internal tooling, and eliminate manual processes. Kubernetes Experience You have experience operating or building on Kubernetes and understand modern cloud-native deployment patterns. GitOps & CI/CD You understand GitOps principles and have experience with tools like ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, or similar deployment and automation platforms. Operational excellence You care deeply about reliability, observability, and operational simplicity. Monitoring, logging, metrics, and incident response are part of how you build software—not an afterthought. Strong Communication Skills You are clear and concise in both written and oral communication whether it be providing status updates or defining requirements in RFC/PRD documents or ticketing system. Collaborative enabler You enjoy partnering with engineering teams, understanding their pain points, and building solutions that improve their day-to-day experience. Ownership mindset You take ownership of problems from discovery through implementation. You look beyond immediate fixes and seek scalable, long-term improvements. Nice to have: Experience in product engineering. Having shipped customer-facing features yourself gives you firsthand empathy for the friction platform tooling can remove, and helps you design capabilities engineers actually want to adopt. What Success Looks Like In this role, success isn't measured by the number of customer-facing features you ship—it's measured by how much easier you've made it for every engineer at Slice to build, deploy, and operate software. You'll Know You're Succeeding When Deployments become faster and more reliable. Engineers spend less time wrestling with infrastructure. Platform capabilities are easy to discover and adopt. Operational toil is replaced with automation. Best practices become the default through well-designed guardrails. Proficient in the use of generative AI tools. Teams can confidently move from idea to production with minimal friction. The Hiring Process Application. 30-minute introductory conversation. 60-minute conversation with department management. 60-minute technical interview with future peers and team members. Offer. Pizza brings people together. Slice is no different. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and embrace a diversity of backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law. We are also proud members of the Diversity Mark NI initiative as a Bronze Member. Privacy Notice Statement of Acknowledgment When you apply for a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Slice. Slice is keeping your data safe and secure. Once we have received your personal data, we put in place reasonable and appropriate measures and controls to prevent any accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, or unauthorised access. If selected, we will process your personal data for hiring /employment processes, as well as our legal obligations. If you are not selected for the job position and you have given consent on the question below (by selecting "Give consent") we will store and process your personal data and submitted documents (CV) to consider eligibility for employment up to 365 days (one year). You have the right to withdraw your previously given consent for storing your personal data and CV in the Slice database considering eligibility for employment for a year. You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. For additional information and / or exercise of your rights to the protection of personal data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer, e-mail: privacy@slice.com

review_candidates.description: Lead Backend Developer (Python/Django) Location: Cairo/Giza, Egypt (Full-time On-site) Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience Employment Type: Full-time About Nexus Analytica Nexus Analytica is a technology company specializing in digital transformation for the energy sector. We develop advanced software platforms that combine data analytics, artificial intelligence, and modern software engineering to help utilities, renewable energy developers, and governments manage increasingly complex energy systems. Our flagship platform, NexusGRID™ , integrates data from renewable energy plants, battery energy storage systems (BESS), smart meters, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and other grid-connected assets to provide real-time monitoring, forecasting, analytics, and intelligent operational decision support. About The Role We are looking for an experienced Senior/Lead Backend Developer to lead the design, development, and evolution of the backend architecture powering NexusGRID. You will play a key role in building highly scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services capable of processing millions of telemetry records from energy assets while maintaining exceptional reliability and performance. You will work closely with frontend developers, data scientists, DevOps engineers, QA engineers, and product stakeholders to deliver enterprise-grade software used by utilities and energy companies worldwide. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, mentoring developers, and shaping the technical direction of a growing software platform. Key Responsibilities Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of backend services. Design scalable REST APIs and backend microservices. Build reliable, secure, and high-performance distributed systems. Develop and maintain enterprise-grade Django applications. Optimize database performance and data models. Design asynchronous processing pipelines using Celery or equivalent technologies. Implement event-driven architectures where appropriate. Ensure code quality through code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate with DevOps engineers to improve deployment and infrastructure automation. Work closely with frontend teams to define API contracts. Collaborate with data scientists to productionize machine learning and forecasting models. Mentor junior and mid-level developers through technical guidance and code reviews. Participate in architectural decisions and technology selection. Troubleshoot production issues and drive root cause analysis. Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and development best practices. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of professional backend software development experience. Extensive experience with Python. Strong professional experience with Django, or equivalent enterprise backend frameworks (such as FastAPI, Flask, Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, or Node.js/NestJS), with the ability to quickly adapt to Django if not already proficient. Strong experience designing RESTful APIs. Deep understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles. Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. Experience with ORM technologies. Experience building scalable backend architectures. Strong understanding of authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect). Experience working with Docker. Experience using Git in collaborative development environments. Experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Strong debugging and performance optimization skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: Django REST Framework Celery Redis RabbitMQ or Kafka WebSockets GraphQL Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform Kubernetes Elasticsearch / OpenSearch TimescaleDB Prometheus & Grafana Nginx Linux server administration Distributed systems Event-driven architectures High-volume data processing IoT platforms Time-series databases Nice to Have Experience developing enterprise SaaS products. Experience in the energy, utilities, IoT, or smart grid sectors. Experience working with telemetry or real-time data systems. Familiarity with protocols such as MQTT or DLMS/COSEM. Experience integrating third-party APIs and industrial systems. Exposure to AI or machine learning deployment workflows. Experience leading agile software teams. What We Look For Strong technical leadership skills. Excellent problem-solving abilities. Passion for writing clean, maintainable, and testable code. Ownership mentality and attention to detail. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to mentor and inspire other developers. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, product-focused environment. Continuous learner with a passion for modern software engineering. What We Offer Competitive salary package. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge energy technology. Exposure to large-scale international projects. Collaborative and highly technical engineering environment. Career growth and leadership opportunities. Modern development tools and workflows. Flexible working arrangements. Professional training and certification support. Opportunity to make a real-world impact on the future of sustainable energy. Technologies We Use Python Django & Django REST Framework PostgreSQL Redis Celery Docker GitHub & GitHub Actions Azure Cloud REST APIs React (Frontend) TypeScript Linux CI/CD pipelines

review_candidates.title: Senior Data Engineer (EconTech) (Contract)
review_candidates.description: What The Role Is MAS is expanding its EconTech capability within the Enterprise Knowledge Department to support the Economic Policy Group (EPG). EconTech is a team of economists who apply econometrics, data science and Artificial Intelligence to novel and large datasets in order to address policy questions across macroeconomic surveillance, inflation, trade and external demand, the labour market, and financial stability. You will be the team’s data engineer, responsible for building and running the data foundations that support EconTech and the wider EPG. You will help implement EPG’s data strategy, covering data acquisition, storage, versioning, documentation and access on enterprise infrastructure. You will design, build, and operate pipelines for structured and unstructured data, including official statistics, licensed data, high-frequency indicators, web data and information extracted from documents. You will turn these into trusted, reusable data products with appropriate metadata, lineage, vintage tracking and validation. A key part of the role is understanding the specific requirements of economic data, including revisions, rebasing, seasonal adjustment, frequencies, units and data vintages. You are not expected to construct econometric models but should understand their data needs and limitations. You will also support AI use cases by developing validation frameworks for LLM-based extraction and classification, and by making data assets safely accessible to AI-assisted workflows within MAS’s governance framework. What You Will Be Working On Data Strategy and Stewardship Own EPG’s data inventory and standards for acquisition, storage, versioning, documentation and sharing. Partner with economists to translate policy and research needs into prioritised data requirements. Work with data owners, platform, governance and security teams to bring data assets onto enterprise infrastructure with appropriate controls. Data Engineering and Products Design and operate production-grade pipelines across statistical, licensed, API, database, file and web sources, with robust validation, monitoring and recovery. Build research-grade datasets that handle revisions, vintages, seasonal adjustment, frequency conversion, rebasing and other economic data requirements. Develop reusable data products and real-time/high-frequency pipelines, with clear schemas, lineage, versioning and programmatic access. Connect data pipelines and products to downstream analytical programmes and BI tools. AI Enablement and Engineering Excellence Build and validate pipelines that extract structured information and insights from documents and text using text analytics and large language models. Make data assets discoverable and safely consumable by AI-assisted workflows through governed, reusable access patterns. Apply and promote strong engineering practices, documentation and monitoring, while guiding junior engineers and representing EconTech in technical discussions. What We Are Looking For Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant quantitative discipline; postgraduate qualifications in Economics or Statistics are an advantage. Around 5–8 years of experience in data engineering, data platforms or statistical systems, supporting economists or quantitative researchers. Experience in central banking, economic policy, official statistics, international organisations or financial-sector research is an advantage. Economic Data Literacy This is a core requirement of the role. Candidates should bring or be able to quickly acquire: Familiarity with key macroeconomic and financial datasets, including how they are sourced, published, revised and maintained across statistical agencies and commercial providers. Working knowledge of economic time-series issues such as vintages, seasonal adjustment, frequency conversion, rebasing, nominal versus real values, and classification changes. Understanding of how data is used in economics research and policy analysis, including the requirements of empirical analysis, nowcasting and forecasting. Technical Competencies Strong proficiency in Python/R and SQL for data transformation, validation and automation. Hands-on experience building and operating cloud-based ETL/ELT pipelines, including orchestration and distributed processing frameworks. Experience integrating structured and unstructured data from APIs, files, databases, feeds and web sources, with practical data modelling for time-series and panel data. Working knowledge of LLM-based information extraction, data governance and sound engineering practices such as Git, testing, CI/CD, logging and monitoring. Core and Behavioural Competencies Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge economists and data engineers. Highly hands-on, with a willingness to build, troubleshoot and operate solutions directly. Ability to deliver end-to-end data solutions independently while collaborating across teams. Sound technical judgement and curiosity about economics and policy. Interested candidates should submit their curriculum vitae highlighting relevant data engineering and data product experience, with emphasis on work done for economists, researchers or statistical teams. Candidates are encouraged to include a brief description (one to two pages) of a data pipeline or dataset they have designed and built for economic, financial or statistical analysis, explaining the data sources involved, the quality and validation issues they had to handle, and how the data was used. You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments. This contract ends in Dec-2028 . As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.
